narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is an enthusiastic shopping vlog and tutorial. The creator shares her excitement about finding Chiikawa-themed gift boxes at 7-Eleven. She demonstrates how viewers can use the Foodomo app to check real-time stock levels at nearby stores to avoid missing out on limited items. It concludes with a promotional giveaway.
